max_drawdown_convention.note: Drawdown LEVELS in this file are NEGATIVE fractions of peak (a -0.25 is a 25% decline). Arithmetic is analytics.metrics.max_drawdown, which returns the positive fraction; research/terrain_strategies negates it once at the emit boundary (D542). Keys matching d_*: differences of two drawdowns, signed by definition.

earned_quantity: log(open(t+1)/close(t)) + log1p(div(t+1)/open(t+1)) at column t -- the NIGHT AFTER the close of bar t; 2 x |pos| turnover units charged every night
hurdle_H: computed, reported, EXCLUDED from every verdict (R7 corollary)
